title: 23andMe DNA kits sold vs. users hit by the 2023 data breach (million people)

source.name: 23andMe customer totals and 2023 credential-stuffing breach disclosure
source.publisher: 23andMe company disclosures / financial press (Good Morning America, Wikipedia summary of SEC/press reporting)

notes: 23andMe has sold more than 12 million DNA kits since its 2006 founding. A 2023 credential-stuffing breach exposed genetic and personal data from nearly 7 million users.
